protocol: target pairs are STRICTLY cross-session (session = YouTube video id, so a different session is a different day, studio, microphone and background)
why_it_matters: slr52_sinhala has n_utts == n_sessions, so it has no within-speaker session structure and its cross-session trials are indistinguishable from cross-utterance ones. This corpus is the only Sinhala data here where a cross-session target trial is genuine.
caveat: 123 speakers total, so the test partition is small and the absolute EER is imprecise (see test_n_eff_cap). The protocol is honest; the precision is not. Use the paired contrasts.
